question: In a queue of commanders, Andry is 17th from the extreme front-end and Brooke is 32ⁿd from the extreme back-end. If the two exchange their positions, Andry becomes 37th from the front end. What is the total number of commanders?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• In a queue of commanders, Andry is 17th from the extreme front-end and Brooke is 32nd from the extreme back-end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3190ba343c025e9c21ce7c5f0b2c6ff859761829da4fae043b35aff240bc9e9.png] 

 
• After interchanging their positions, Andry becomes 37th from the front end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be1f26671bfad59da5b916a19dbc0453a19febd71f3c7a173054d605413865de.png] 

 
• Total number of commanders = Position of Andry from the front end after interchanging positions + Position of Andry from the back end after interchanging positions - 1 = 37 + 32 - 1

∴ Total number of commanders = 68

Hence, the correct answer is **"68".**
